briefing.headline: Speed brain: Slow charts
good: Other brains: LOCK-IN spike wave: 6 sign-ups in 3 h vs ~2.1 (×2.8) · Money brain: Checkout leak · Data brain: Over budget · Security brain: Headless flood · Content brain: Gaps · Fixer brain: Backlog · Traffic brain: Surge
watch: Admin: Chart pages: the slowest 10% of real loads take 12s — phones 3.02s vs desktop 16s (46% of loads on phones); the server answers in 0.23s and candles in 0.19s (MISS) — the time is on the visitor's side. Desktops are slower than phones, so it is not phone CPU — something desktop loads (more candles, panels, a far country) is the lead. A headless flood is on (US: 167 raw vs ~9.6, 2 stayed, CN: 161 raw vs ~5.7, 0 stayed, GB: 75 raw vs ~5.9, 1 stayed, CA: 51 raw vs ~0.9, 1 stayed) — its loads pollute the desktop number; trust phones until it stops. Most slow-load time sits in: desktop/IN 20s ×53, mobile/IR 23s ×12, mobile/PK 16s ×15, mobile/IN 5.1s ×37. Needs a build session to profile one slow load.
